sources.title: District Boundary
sources.organisation: NWIC National Water Data Portal (producer metadata: Geological Survey of India; page branding: Survey of India)
sources.licence: Portal copyright policy: free reuse with prominent source acknowledgement; no dataset-level licence field shown
sources.limitations: District boundaries change; check the data date. Not an official map.

sources.title: State Boundary (states and UTs)
sources.organisation: NWIC National Water Data Portal (producer metadata: Geological Survey of India; page branding: Survey of India)
sources.licence: Portal copyright policy: free reuse with prominent source acknowledgement; no dataset-level licence field shown
sources.limitations: Not confirmed as the legal external boundary of India. Analysis use only; do not present as an official map.

sources.title: Glacial Lakes (Himalayan states)
sources.organisation: Central Water Commission (CWC) via NWIC National Water Data Portal
sources.licence: No dataset-level licence field shown; acknowledge source
sources.limitations: Static inventory. Current lake change is only in CWC monthly PDF reports (manual).

sources.title: HydroRIVERS v1.0 - Asia (river reaches with downstream links)
sources.organisation: HydroSHEDS (WWF, McGill University and partners) - international gap-filler
sources.note: HTTP 403. Not downloaded; no retry or workaround.
sources.licence: HydroSHEDS licence agreement: free with attribution (read it on hydrosheds.org)
sources.limitations: Built from ~500 m terrain data: small Himalayan streams are missing; discharge values are MODELLED long-term averages. Candidate URL unverified: the pipeline records whether it worked.

sources.title: River Network (river lines)
sources.organisation: Central Water Commission (CWC) via NWIC National Water Data Portal
sources.coverage: Rivers (completeness not stated by the portal)
sources.licence: 'Other (Open)' on the resource page; acknowledge source
sources.limitations: Flow direction and connectivity are not documented. Used here only for river NAMES, never for downstream tracing.

sources.title: NDMA SACHET CAP alerts
sources.licence: Check NDMA terms; attribution to the issuing agency shown with every alert
sources.limitations: District matching is by CAP polygon where given, otherwise by name (lower confidence). Alerts are official warnings, not SHAILDHARA forecasts.
